scope_source: Six product links explicitly supplied by the user, comprising three S.W.A.T. Trail Edition variants and three ONYX variants, plus the Men Trail collection.

benefit_evidence.swat: OFFLIMITS positions S.W.A.T. Trail Edition as a mid-cut boot for trails, outdoor training and rugged conditions. Product copy connects the outsole with traction, cushioning and shock absorption; canvas/mesh with breathability; synthetic sections with structure; EVA with a soft flexible feel; and memory foam with cushioning.
benefit_evidence.onyx: OFFLIMITS positions ONYX for hiking, trails and outdoor training. Product copy connects KPU/Flyknit with breathability, flexibility, structure and protection; the moulded-socks insock with a soft contoured feel; and Phylon/TPR with cushioning, flexibility, traction and shock absorption.

source_handling: Where narrative copy conflicts with the structured specification fields, the structured fields are used.
Slip-resistant/non-slip language is translated into traction-focused guidance rather than a universal grip guarantee.
Prices, stock and review counts are omitted because they are time-sensitive.
The product scope follows the user's explicit six-link list, including S.W.A.T. products housed in the S.W.A.T. collection as well as ONYX products housed in Men Trail.
